notes.title: Version 1.0.2 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Thank you for supporting ABYSSAL BLADE! It's been one week since release and we have been excited as more and more people experience our game. Thus, patch 1.0.2 is focused on expanding our reach and enabling more systems to run the game without crashing.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Mac Version Enabled![/b][/h2][p]The macOS build is now available! Before buying, please download the free demo to confirm it runs smoothly on your machine. The game requires a Mac with at least an M1 chip; for optimal performance, we recommend an M2 or newer.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637557/c3ed22244930ad0a9d398ba1825058839e54b9cb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Compatibility Mode is Now Available![/b][/h2][p]Some players reported crashes at launch or heavy lag on the title screen. We traced the problem to older GPUs and integrated graphics, which struggled with our default, high-end renderer (Vulkan Forward+). To resolve this, we’ve added a Compatibility Mode designed to let those systems run the game more smoothly. If your game had been running smoothly previously, please continue to use the Recommended launch. We hope to hear any feedback regarding the new launch option![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637557/8e1285ef5afb04a6e67e0ac122f2f3554e93748e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Hot Fixes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed issue where boss HP % label would sometimes incorrectly show 100% despite it being lower[/p][/*][*][p]Changed name of 'Slash' and 'Cleave' to 'Light ATK' and 'Heavy ATK', respectively, in Controls (hopefully this provides greater clarity on the difference between the two attacks)[/p][/*][*][p]Added tutorial pop-up the first time you use an attack input to inform the player that they can hold the attack inputs to continue attacking (to prevent figure fatigue lol)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where player could Alt-F4 after dying to a boss mechanic and not incur a death[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: The macOS build is now available! Before buying, please download the free demo to confirm it runs smoothly on your machine. The game requires a Mac with at least an M1 chip; for optimal performance, we recommend an M2 or newer.

Some players reported crashes at launch or heavy lag on the title screen. We traced the problem to older GPUs and integrated graphics, which struggled with our default, high-end renderer (Vulkan Forward+). To resolve this, we’ve added a Compatibility Mode designed to let those systems run the game more smoothly. If your game had been running smoothly previously, please continue to use the Recommended launch. We hope to hear any feedback regarding the new launch option!

tags.bug: Fixed issue where boss HP % label would sometimes incorrectly show 100% despite it being lower

tags.feature: Changed name of 'Slash' and 'Cleave' to 'Light ATK' and 'Heavy ATK', respectively, in Controls (hopefully this provides greater clarity on the difference between the two attacks)
Added tutorial pop-up the first time you use an attack input to inform the player that they can hold the attack inputs to continue attacking (to prevent figure fatigue lol)

tags.bug: Fixed issue where player could Alt-F4 after dying to a boss mechanic and not incur a death

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Thank you for supporting ABYSSAL BLADE! We are super excited to hear all of the feedback. Since launch, we have encountered some bugs and have been working to address them. [/p][p]If you encounter any additional bugs, please let us know in our Discord. That would be greatly appreciated. Now onto the patch notes for 1.0.1![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed issue where an achievement wasn't being rewarded despite choosing the "Bad Ending"[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where Vanquishing Slash damage would not register near the outside of the hitbox in Acceptance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where progress gems were displayed incorrectly on the Load Data screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where some SFX were too quiet or muted during several cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where, in a rare case, the Orb Buff in Depression doesn't get used, resulting in an extra buff[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Ongoing Issue: Implementing Compatibility Mode[/b][/h2][list][*][p]We received some reports that the game would immediately crash on launch, or, in some rare cases, be playable with extreme lag. We looked into this issue further and found that our build is not yet optimized for integrated GPUs and older graphics cards.[/p][/*][*][p]We are working on an alternative launch option for [i]Compatibility Mode[/i] in hopes of giving these users a different mode to launch our game. Stay tuned![/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed issue where an achievement wasn't being rewarded despite choosing the "Bad Ending"
Fixed issue where Vanquishing Slash damage would not register near the outside of the hitbox in Acceptance
Fixed issue where progress gems were displayed incorrectly on the Load Data screen
Fixed issue where some SFX were too quiet or muted during several cutscenes
Fixed issue where, in a rare case, the Orb Buff in Depression doesn't get used, resulting in an extra buff
